_comment: Cards Forge has a script for that we know don't work right. The deck editor marks them with the reason. Remove an entry once Forge or an override in overrides/cards fixes the card, then run `npm run cardsupport` in web/. `issue` is the Forge bug report to watch.

Esix, Fractal Bloom.reason: When an effect makes several tokens at once (Terastodon, Ezuri's Predation), only the first one can become a copy.

Garruk, Veiled Butcher.reason: Its -3 can discard fewer than two cards per opponent, and its exile replacement applies outside the battlefield. A fix is waiting in Forge.

Lifecraft Engine.reason: Vehicles stop having the chosen creature type after the first time they stop being creatures.

Out of Time.reason: If its controller loses the game, the phased-out creatures never phase back in.

Outpost Siege.reason: Khans: if you start casting the exiled card and cancel, you can't cast it again that turn.

Sin Prodder.reason: Its upkeep trigger can freeze multiplayer games, waiting forever for an opponent's choice.
